feeds.title: Rapzilla
feeds.description: Rapzilla is a Christian hip-hop blog that was founded in 2003. The blog's mission is to engage hip-hop culture with the gospel of Jesus Christ. They provide news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists.

feeds.title: Trackstarz
feeds.description: Trackstarz is a Christian media company determined to bring high-quality Godly content to the mainstream. We have a heart for training young creatives to improve their craft and character to prepare them for Marketplace influence.

feeds.title: Gospel Hotspot » Christian Hip-Hop / Rap songs
feeds.description: Gospel Hotspot is a Christian hip-hop blog that features songs, videos, news, and articles about Christian rap music. They aim to promote Christian hip-hop and spread the gospel through music.

feeds.title: Journal of Gospel Music » Christian Rap/Hip Hop
feeds.description: The Journal of Gospel Music is a blog that covers gospel music, including Christian rap. They provide news, interviews, reviews, and articles related to Christian rap and other forms of gospel music. The mission of the Journal of Gospel Music is to educate and enlighten the public about gospel music as an American art form. Its vision is to be the premier online resource for gospel music news, reviews, and scholarship.

feeds.title: The Bookkeeper 247
feeds.description: The Bookkeeper 247 is a Christian hip-hop blog that features news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists. They aim to promote Christian hip-hop and encourage artists to use their platform to spread the gospel message. Bookkeeper 247 understands the influence music has on our lives. So, on our website, we have Christian content 4 the culture! Help us change the culture 4 God as we become the voice in Christian hip hop!

feeds.title: Holy Culture
feeds.description: Holy Culture is a Christian hip-hop blog that features news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists. They aim to provide a platform for Christian hip-hop artists to share their music and message with the world.

feeds.title: RiP Records Blog
feeds.description: RiP Records Blog is a Christian hip-hop blog that features news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists. They aim to promote Christian hip-hop and encourage artists to use their platform to spread the gospel message.

feeds.title: Christianity Today » Hip-Hop
feeds.description: Christianity Today was founded in 1956 by Billy Graham. It aims to engage and equip the Christian community through providing news, commentary, and resources for understanding the world from a Christian perspective. Their Hip-Hop subpage covers the intersection of Christianity and hip-hop culture, highlighting the voices of Christian rappers and producers, and exploring the relationship between faith and hip-hop music.

feeds.title: Jesus Wired » Hip Hop Rap
feeds.description: JesusWired.com is a Christian music news site specializing in the latest news, album reviews and interviews from both major label and indie artists. With a main focus on shining a light on the indie artists you need to know about, we're also determined to bridge the gap between the genres dominating at radio and those that aren't. Christian music is the hope this world needs, let's help get it out to the masses!

feeds.title: Blessed Beatz Blog
feeds.description: Blessed Beatz Radio is positive and inspirational hip hop radio station, under the network of A Better Entertainment, LLC , with an edge to the merging of a pop-culture and faith; that can be aired in multiple markets around the country. The objectives for Blessed Beatz Radio are to inspire, empower, and uplift communities and listeners in a positive way.

feeds.title: Gospel Hydration » Christian Hip Hop
feeds.description: At Gospel Hydration, we get people talking. We fuel the Christian entertainment culture conversation. We build up youth, nurture their creativity and stand up for the Faith they believe in. And of course, Christian music is at the heart of everything we do. We are the music plug bringing audiences the newest music through to the biggest Christian artists. More than anything, we aim to entertain and refresh wherever and whenever.

feeds.title: Christian Hip Hop Now
feeds.description: Christian Hip Hop Now was founded by a team of passionate Christian hip-hop enthusiasts in 2015. Their vision is to promote Christian hip-hop music and culture and to provide a platform for Christian hip-hop artists to showcase their music. They share news, reviews, and interviews with Christian hip-hop artists and also provide resources for aspiring artists.

feeds.title: Blessed Circle Music Blog
feeds.description: Blessed Circle Music Blog is a Christian hip-hop blog founded by Jay Thornton in 2011. Their mission is to create a platform that inspires, educates, and entertains through Christian hip-hop music. They cover Christian hip-hop news, reviews, interviews, and provide insights into the Christian hip-hop industry.

feeds.title: Global Money World » Global Media Christian
feeds.description: Global Money World Christian is a blog founded by Big Buji in 2008. Their mission is to provide a platform for independent artists to showcase their music and to connect with fans and other artists. They cover various genres of music, including Christian hip-hop, and share news, reviews, and interviews with independent artists.

feeds.title: Prafit Josiah Music Blog
feeds.description: Prafit Josiah Music Blog is a Christian hip-hop blog that features news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists. They aim to promote Christian hip-hop and encourage listeners to use the music to deepen their faith.

feeds.title: CCM Magazine » Christian Rap
feeds.description: CCM Magazine is a Christian music blog that features news, reviews, and interviews of Christian rap artists. They aim to promote Christian hip-hop and encourage listeners to use the music to deepen their faith.

feeds.title: The Oracle Mag Blog » Christian Hip-Hop
feeds.description: The Oracle Mag Blog was founded in 2010 by Antwan Lindsey. Their mission is to be a source for Christian hip-hop news, album reviews, and interviews. They cover various topics related to Christian hip-hop culture, including the history of the genre, social issues, and the latest releases from Christian hip-hop artists.
